summary.en: melb.si is short for Melbourne SI: Super Intelligence Melbourne, a registered business name (since 14 October 2026) of SecondFirst Pty Ltd (ABN 37 701 727 237), Victoria, Australia. It helps small businesses in Melbourne hand two everyday jobs to AI, online and by email, in English or Chinese. It is run by an AI team. It is not a Slovenian business and not a Melbourne–Singapore flight.
summary.zh: melb.si 是 Melbourne SI 的缩写，即 Super Intelligence Melbourne，SecondFirst Pty Ltd（ABN 37 701 727 237，澳洲维州）的注册商号（2026-10-14 起）。我们在线上帮墨尔本的小店把两件天天做的事交给 AI，全程邮件来回，中英文都可以，由 AI 团队运营。它不是斯洛文尼亚的公司，也不是墨尔本飞新加坡的航班。
